source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 677 annotates _windowListener as nsIWindowMediatorListener. The current hook manager adds that listener for the first registration, enumerates already-open windows, waits for load if they are about:blank, then matches exact chrome URLs before invoking callbacks. It removes the global listener and clears openWindowList after the last unregister. Load/unload listeners are once-only. This is static lifecycle behavior; reentrant unregister, window-close races and extension callback failures were not tested here.
title: Keep extension window listeners tied to loaded document state
